definitions.explanation: A person or people of the opposite sex. Used when discussing attraction, relationships, and social interactions between men and women.

examples.japanese: {異性|いせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧はいます⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Do you have friends of the opposite sex?

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{異性|いせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: He is very popular with the opposite sex.

examples.japanese: {異性|いせい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{慣|な}れていない→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{緊張|きんちょう}して→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧⟦{話|はな}せなかった→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: I wasn't used to interacting with the opposite sex, so I was nervous and couldn't speak well.

notes:
USAGE:
{異性|いせい} is a neutral, standard term for the opposite sex. It is commonly used in discussions about relationships, attraction, and social dynamics. The antonym is ⟦{同性|どうせい}→同性：18314_dousei⟧ (same sex).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {異性|いせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{好|す}かれる→好く：30762_suku⟧ (be liked by the opposite sex)
- {異性|いせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧ (friend of the opposite sex)
- {異性|いせい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交際|こうさい}→交際：02800_kousai⟧ (dating someone of the opposite sex)
- {異性|いせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{意識|いしき}する→意識する：17974_ishikisuru⟧ (become aware of the opposite sex)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{同性|どうせい}→同性：18314_dousei⟧: the same sex (antonym)
- ⟦{男女|だんじょ}→男女：03117_danjo⟧: men and women (refers to both sexes together)
- ⟦{異性愛|いせいあい}→異性愛：25188_iseiai⟧: heterosexuality (sexual orientation)
